name: keyart_hero_panorama
why: Art-directed extra pass (plan_v5_b4x.json): Keeper clearly walking toward the sun along a rising laminated ribbon, single warm light, no village lights or lighthouse, clean night-to-dawn sweep with a wide empty sky for the wordmark; beats plan v1-v3 which add warm window lights and a sitting Keeper.

name: keyart_store_1_kaamos
why: Most open caption sky, crisp four-line laminated ledge, Keeper and lantern well placed in the lower third; also used as the composition ref for stores 2-5 (copied to art/final2/keyart/).

name: keyart_store_2_first_light
why: Clearest ski ride pose with lantern forward and the strongest lilac horizon lift while keeping the series composition.

name: keyart_store_3_blue_hour
why: Cleanest swan constellation as one honey line, ice-blue water, no stray aurora competing with the swan.

name: keyart_store_4_first_green
why: Fullest laminated aurora ribbons and the Keeper holding the lantern up, the strongest green-return beat.

name: keyart_store_5_dawn
why: Honey sun right of centre with the longest clean sun path and the Keeper raising the lantern toward it.

name: bg_start
why: Faithful high-fidelity re-render of the approved start plate; softest lilac horizon glow gives the most depth; variants are near-identical.

name: bg_end_dawn
why: Smoothest lilac-to-apricot sky and the cleanest sun path; matches the end plate.

name: bg_end_night
why: Calmest aurora and dusk-lilac horizon, lantern and far windows as the only warm points.

name: bg_patient
why: Matches the patient plate with the cleanest birch and shoreline curves; variants near-identical.
